class.name: CgameSafeArea
class.description: [CgameSafeArea] converts the safe area reported by the display (notches, rounded corners, TV overscan, handheld bezels) into per-side insets, so that HUD margins grow by the part of the window that is unsafe and nothing important is drawn under a cut-out. Insets are dictionaries with the integer keys [code]left[/code], [code]top[/code], [code]right[/code] and [code]bottom[/code]. All methods are static.

method.name: apply
method.description: Sets the four [code]margin_*[/code] theme constant overrides of [param margin] to [param base] plus the matching entry of [param insets]. Does nothing if [param margin] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: current
method.description: Returns the insets of the main window in the 2D canvas space of [param viewport], using [method DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area]. Returns zero insets for a [code]null[/code] viewport and on a headless display server.

method.name: from_display
method.description: Converts a safe rectangle in screen coordinates into insets in canvas units. The rectangle is moved into window space with [param window_position], then the window pixel insets are scaled from [param window_size] to [param canvas_size] to account for stretch modes.

method.name: insets
method.description: Returns the per-side insets in window pixels of a window of [param window_size] whose safe rectangle, in the same pixel space, is [param safe_rect]. A safe rectangle larger than the window gives no inset; degenerate input gives zero insets.

constants.constant: The default base margin in pixels used by [method apply].
